name: battle
description: Activates Antigravity's Colosseum Battle Mode. Pits two rival subagents in isolated branched workspaces against each other, stress-tests competing implementations with an adversarial referee, and merges the winning solution.

name: benchmark
description: Replaces guesswork with empirical hardware telemetry: synthesizes ad-hoc stress-test harnesses on the fly, executes them headlessly, and proves performance gains with hard numbers.

name: compaction
description: Triggers on-demand context compaction: persists critical state into durable artifacts, flushes obsolete transient turn history, and signals the runtime to compact context.

name: owl
description: Activates the OWL (Optimized Workforce Learning) decoupled multi-agent pipeline: uses DeepInvestigator for root-cause analysis and edge-case attacks, and DeepCoder for verified code synthesis and iterative improvement.
